title: CompilerReceipt
description: Spec §8 CompilerReceipt (R-005). Fields compiler, lang, options and diagnostic_class added in spec 0.3.0 (ADR-0004). diagnostic_class values unbound_symbol, resource_limit and internal added in spec 0.3.2 (ADR-0005, Danny yes 2026-10-17 1:13 PM PT). Optional termination_signal, runtime_stack_overflow and wasm_trap record how the worker stopped. schema_version 0.3.2.

lang.description: Faust output backend, for example cpp, c, rust, cmajor, wasm

termination_signal.description: POSIX signal that killed the worker. Absent when the process exited on its own.

runtime_stack_overflow.description: True when the JS runtime itself raised RangeError or Maximum call stack size exceeded. Absent means it did not.

wasm_trap.description: Wasm trap kind reported by the runtime, for example unreachable. Absent when the runtime reported no trap.
